title: This render ran out of memory
outOfMemoryHint: The graphics card could not fit this render, even after the engine retried it smaller. Any of these will make it fit:

suggestionHint.lower_resolution: Drops this node to {pct} of full size. Quality goes with it, and nothing else in the video changes.
suggestionHint.smaller_model: Switches this node to a lighter model you already have: {vram} GB instead of {was} GB.
suggestionHint.cloud: Renders this on someone else's hardware, billed to your own API key. Opens Settings, where the key goes.

alreadySmallest: This node is already at the smallest size worth rendering.
noSmallerModel: No smaller model for this step is installed. Settings - Models has the full library.
unknownSuggestion: This build does not know how to act on that suggestion.
retryingOffload: Retrying at {pct}, offloading to system memory - attempt {n}
